text: Kaa hara ɓee fennuɓe ko Nulaaɗo on (yo Alla juulu e makko hisna) addi kon yahaali ka leydi; fii yo ɓe yi'u batteeji ɗen ca'e halkanooɗe, ɓe miijitora hakkillaaji maɓɓe ɗin fii yo ɓe tasko, ɓe nana fillayeeji maɓɓe ɗin nanɗe jaɓugol fii yo ɓe waajito, pellet mbunɗan gite ɗen wanaa ɗan woni mbunɗan ɗan, ko woni, mbunɗan halkayɗan ɗan yeeba ko mbunɗan giiɗe ɓernde ɗan, nde tawnoo laatantaako jom majjan taskagol wanaa kadi waajitagol.
